_comment: One of the shepherd's three named strays — once a talk_to target for `the-strays` (no longer offered, R7), now a stray to drive home in `back-to-the-pen`. Copied field for field from dog.json, which is the game's only other talkable animal: faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. Those two knobs are what make the quest zero-combat BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by hoping the player behaves: the animal cannot be killed, so the objective cannot be failed. role creature; it authored speed 0 until it became a herd animal (see below). xpFactor 0 keeps it off the nameplate path. aggroRadius 1.0 is required-but-inert; interaction.range 2.0 is the wider of the two and sizes the one sensor. ⭐ WHY THREE DEFINITIONS AND NOT ONE WITH count 3: talk_to is keyed by the DEFINITION id, never the spawn — sys/interaction.go stamps a.MobID(), and quests.talkedTo persists as a sorted array of those ids — so three spawns of one definition are ONE key, and talking to any one would satisfy all three at once. A count there is unsatisfiable-or-instant, never 1-of-3, which is why quests.go firstCountable skips talk_to entirely. The engine could be taught to count DISTINCT ENTITIES instead, but entity ids are process-local by design (L12), so the count would not survive a restart — deferred until a second quest needs it. ⭐ NAMING THEM IS WHAT MAKES THREE FILES HONEST (PO 2026-09-20): three sheep SPECIES was a workaround wearing a costume, while three named individuals is what the content actually is — Baabara, Woolliam and Lambert are specific animals the shepherd knows, and the generic `Sheep` beside them is the flock they wandered off from. ⚑ THE NAMES FORCE THE QUEST'S `tracker`: the derived journal line is hardcoded 'Talk to the ' + name (quests/ledger.go) with no displayName field anywhere, so 'Talk to the Baabara' would read wrong. An authored objective tracker rewords just that line and keeps its ✓, which is why each of the-strays' objectives authors one ('Find Baabara'). ⚑ ONE NODE, NO OPTIONS — an authored-empty node is a legal lore leaf (the empty-destination prune spares it), and talking is all this quest needs: the ledger stamps NoteTalkedTo on session-open, not on a row click. ⭐ AND IT IS WHAT MAKES THEM FINDABLE: the generic Sheep authors NO interaction at all, so the three that answer are exactly the three the quest wants. ⛑ entityType Sheep, the placeholder sheep (plan-herding.md R13, D11; was NpcPlaceholder, and before that a Stag reuse), shared by all four sheep; the real sprite comes at the Zone 1 art pass. ⭐ A HERD ANIMAL since plan-herding.md R15/D12: stage 2 of `back-to-the-pen` asks for it back in `hans-pen` (`herd` Lambert, count 1), and it runs from players like the flock. IN BETWEEN: the flock's own numbers (speed 0.6, run radius 2.5); he grazes by the Rockfall west of the pasture. aggroRadius is the run radius; collisionMask 80 lets fences hold it; talking is optional (R16) and holds it still while the panel is open (D13). It still carries its own definition, which is what lets the quest count it apart from the flock. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: Lambert
